proposal.summary: Batch L1 is CM550's fuel limit side paths around cm550_selectFinalFueling and the start-up list. 0x16dd4 is not a high RPM protection. It is the engine warmup protection (e2m 11EA / 11EB): after the engine has been off long enough for the oil to drain back (3 min here), the next start is fuel limited from an engine speed table. The limit stays until oil pressure has been above a threshold for a set time and a coolant-temperature based rifle to turbocharger oil delay has passed, or until the overall or fault time runs out. 0x1709e is its start-up initializer and the already named 0x17120 applies the limit. 0x1c0d4 converts the torque derate torque limit (lb-ft) into a fuel limit and resets it. It is the counterpart of CM848 0x1e4e8, which does the same conversion but leaves the reset to its caller. 0x1c308 initializes that limit at start-up. 0x1cc72 computes the e2m 105A 100 percent throttle fuelings, the counterpart of cm848_calculateThrottle100Fuelings. 0x3452a is the exact twin of CM848's hour meter loader. The HIGH_RPM_PROTECTION_STATE / HIGH_RPM_PROTECTION_FLAGS enums have no user in either firmware and should be deleted. The FLAGS masks are the J1587 PID 71 idle shutdown timer status byte that CM550 builds in a register at 0xefa2.

functions.role: One 50 ms pass of the engine warmup protection state machine: arms the protection after the oil drain-back time with the engine stopped, ends it on established oil pressure plus the coolant-based rifle to turbocharger delay (or the overall / fault time) and sets engine_warmup_protection_fuel_limit.
functions.discriminator: The only body with the engine_state switch and the five warmup timers (WPRYTM, WPTMMX, WPFUTM, WPO2TDTM, WPDYTM), and the only writer of engine_warmup_protection_fuel_limit (stores at 0x16e22 / 0x16eb2 / 0x16fd4 / 0x1706a / 0x17092, from the engine speed table or fuel_demand_maximum). 0x1709e reads the same enable bit but runs once at start-up and only seeds the flags and lookup descriptors. 0x17120 only applies the limit to torque_derate_fuel_quantity.
functions.plate_comment: The engine warmup protection state machine (e2m 11EA / 11EB, enable WPEAFG = algorithm_enable_flags_18_cal bit 1), one pass per 50 ms from cm550_runEvery10FramesTaskSetPhase0. With the engine STOPPED it counts engine_warmup_protection_oil_drain_back_timer up to engine_warmup_protection_oil_drain_back_time (3 min here). At that time it arms the protection: engine_warmup_protection_fuel_limiting_flag 1, completed 0, WPACFT 1, and low_speed_governor_lock_flag when LSLOCN is set. While cranking / running / jump start / reentry it ends the protection (completed 1, limiting 0) at the maximum overall time, at the maximum time with an active and latched coolant or oil pressure fault, or when the rifle to turbocharger delay has run out; that delay is looked up from coolant temperature (WPCQXA / WPDYTMYA) once oil pressure has stayed at or above WPO2TDCN for WPO2TMCN. While limiting it sets engine_warmup_protection_fuel_limit (WPTQLM) from the engine speed table (WPESXA / WPFLDQYA); it sets fuel_demand_maximum otherwise, and also when the feature is disabled, inhibited (WPIHFG), or completed with the engine running; cm550_applyEngineWarmupProtectionFuelLimit applies it (was cm550_highRpmEngineProtectionStateMachine - nothing in it is about high engine speed).

functions.role: Start-up initializer of the engine warmup protection: seeds the limiting / completed / low speed governor lock flags from the enable bit, clears the inhibit flag and loads the two lookup descriptors.
functions.discriminator: Runs once (the only caller is jsr @0x28810 in mc68k_applicationMain). It is the only writer of the two lookup descriptors 0x80058e / 0x80059c and the only code that sets limiting 1 / completed 0 straight from the enable bit with no timing. The pass function 0x16dd4 reads the same bit but runs the timers.
functions.plate_comment: Start-up initialization of the engine warmup protection, called once from mc68k_applicationMain after cm550_initializeLowSpeedGovernor. It clears engine_warmup_protection_inhibit_flag (e2m 11EA +16 WPIHFG). With WPEAFG (algorithm_enable_flags_18_cal bit 1) set it arms the protection for the first start: engine_warmup_protection_fuel_limiting_flag 1, engine_warmup_protection_completed_flag 0, and low_speed_governor_lock_flag 1 when engine_warmup_protection_low_speed_governor_lock_enable is set. With the bit clear it sets limiting 0 and completed 1. It also sets up the two lookupTableInterpolation descriptors of cm550_runEngineWarmupProtection: 0x80058e maps coolant temperature (11EF WPCQXA at 0x60846) to the rifle to turbocharger delay time (11EE WPDYTMYA at 0x6085a), and 0x80059c maps engine speed (11ED WPESXA at 0x607f2) to the fueling derate (11EC WPFLDQYA at 0x6081c). No fuel temperature is involved (was cm550_fuelTemperatureLimitingSecondary).
functions.evidence: Disassembly 0x1709e-0x1711e: a2 = 0x80059c, a3 = 0x80058e, a1 = 0x80ccb4, a0 = 0x80ccb2. clr.w 0x80ccc8 @0x170ba. andi.w #2 of 0x803cb8 @0x170c0: set -> move.w #1,(a0), clr.w (a1), and when tst.w 0x807dde is nonzero move.w #1 to 0x80a8f4 (0x170cc-0x170da); clear -> clr.w (a0), move.w #1,(a1) (0x170e4). Then move.l #0x60846,(2,a3); move.w #2 to 0x80058e; move.l #0x6085a,(8,a3); move.l #0x607f2,(2,a2); move.w #2 to 0x80059c; move.l #0x6081c,(8,a2) (0x170ea-0x17112). e2m_block_addresses --address: 0x60846 = 11EF WPCQXA, 0x6085a = 11EE WPDYTMYA, 0x607f2 = 11ED WPESXA, 0x6081c = 11EC WPFLDQYA. Only caller jsr @0x28810 (mc68k_applicationMain), followed by jsr 0x30c78 (d0 unused). No CM848 warmup protection exists (CHR e2m has no WP* record).

functions.role: Converts the torque derate torque limit (lb-ft) into a fuel quantity, lowers torque_derate_fuel_quantity with it, then resets the torque limit to no limit for the next pass.
functions.discriminator: The only body that turns torque_derate_torque_limit into fuel: no load + limit x (throttle_100_fueling_without_programmable_power - no load) / maximum torque at the current speed. It is also the per-pass writer of the 0xFFFF / 40 reset. applyPowerTakeOffTorqueLimit only lowers the torque limit; the other chain steps lower torque_derate_fuel_quantity directly.
functions.plate_comment: Converts the torque derate torque limit (e2m 1051 +A TQDQTQ, lb-ft, 0xFFFF = none) into a fuel limit. It interpolates on the line from no_load_fuel_quantity at zero torque to throttle_100_fueling_without_programmable_power (105A +8 FSMTFLNP) at maximum_torque_at_current_engine_speed (1461 +0 MTMPRPFL; a 0 there is first replaced by 1): no load + limit x (FSMTFLNP - no load) / maximum torque through cm550_scaleByRatioSigned, floored at 0. When the result is below torque_derate_fuel_quantity it becomes the new minimum with torque_derate_torque_limit_state as torque_derate_fuel_source_code. The limit is then reset to 0xFFFF and FUELING_STATE_NO_DERATE (40) for the next pass. Called by cm550_selectFinalFueling right after cm550_runFuelLimitChains, where applyPowerTakeOffTorqueLimit lowers the limit. Counterpart of CM848 0x1e4e8, which converts the same way but leaves the reset to its caller cm848_arbitrateRequestedFueling, which resets before the chain (was cm550_FUN_0001c0d4).
functions.evidence: CM550 0x1c0d4-0x1c150 (a2 = 0x80db1a, a3 = 0x80d33a, a4 = 0x80dec8, a5 = 0x80db1c): cmpi.w #1,(a2); bcc; move.w #1,(a2) (0 -> 1). Pushes the long max torque (a2), 0x80d370 - (a5), then 0x80d338, and jsr 0x35076 cm550_scaleByRatioSigned (= limit x (FSMTFLNP - no load) / max torque). add.l (a5); bge or 0; cmp.l with (a4); bge skips, else move.w d2,(a4) and move.w (a3),0x80deca. Then move.w #0xffff,0x80d338 @0x1c140 and move.w #0x28,(a3) @0x1c148. CM848 0x1e4e8-0x1e5a0: lhz 0x40aee6, 0 -> li 1 sth; (lhz 0x40a89f - lhz 0x40aeec) mulhw/mullw lhz 0x40a2d8; bl 0x570f0 (64-bit divide) by 0x40aee6; add no load; floor 0. If lhz 0x40afac > result: sth 0x40afac and lha 0x40a2da -> sth 0x40afae. Then blr, with no reset. Steps 1-4 match one for one; CM550's step 5 (the reset) is absent, so the code differs: counterpart. CM848 cm848_arbitrateRequestedFueling 0x1e5a4 stores 0xffff / FUELING_STATE_NO_DERATE before cm848_processProtectionLimits then calls 0x1e4e8. CM550 callers: bsr.w @0x1c190 only (cm550_selectFinalFueling, only while torque_derate_override_enable is clear). Same records on both sides: 1051 +A / +C, 105A +8 FSMTFLNP (CM550 0x80d370 / CM848 0x40a89f), 109C +0 NLFL. RAM dump: limit 0xFFFF, state 40, max torque 330, no load 88.

functions.role: Start-up initialization of the torque derate torque limit pair to no limit (0xFFFF) and FUELING_STATE_NO_DERATE.
functions.discriminator: Writes only the torque limit pair and is called only once at start-up (jsr @0x28970 in mc68k_applicationMain). The per-pass reset of the same pair happens inside cm550_convertTorqueDerateTorqueLimitToFuelLimit, after the conversion.
functions.plate_comment: Start-up initialization of the torque derate torque limit, called once from mc68k_applicationMain. It sets torque_derate_torque_limit (e2m 1051 +A TQDQTQ) to 0xFFFF (no limit) and torque_derate_torque_limit_state (1051 +C TQDQTQST) to FUELING_STATE_NO_DERATE (40), so the first pass of the fuel limit chains starts unlimited. cm550_convertTorqueDerateTorqueLimitToFuelLimit repeats the same reset after every pass. CM848 has no start-up writer of the pair: its per-pass reset is in cm848_arbitrateRequestedFueling (was cm550_FUN_0001c308).
functions.evidence: Disassembly 0x1c308: move.w #0xffff,(0x80d338).l; move.w #0x28,(0x80d33a).l; rts. Only caller jsr @0x28970 (mc68k_applicationMain, after jsr 0x26a2e, the maximum torque map descriptor set-up). CM848 .cpp: torque_derate_torque_limit is stored only in cm848_arbitrateRequestedFueling (0xffff, line 20741) and applyPowerTakeOffTorqueLimit (line 29677), so it has no start-up initializer -> no counterpart.

functions.role: Computes the e2m 105A 100 percent throttle fuelings: throttle_100_fueling, the low horsepower curve value, the fuel at the ramped engine speed limit and the fuel without programmable power, with the cold temperature fuel increment.
functions.discriminator: The only writer of 105A +0 / +2 / +4 / +8 (0x80d368 / 0x80d36a / 0x80d36c / 0x80d370). Its siblings only read them: initializeFuelLimitChains reads throttle_100_fueling, cm550_updateElectronicSmartPowerTau reads the low horsepower curve, cm550_convertTorqueDerateTorqueLimitToFuelLimit reads +8. It is also the only reader of full_fueling_coolant_temperature_adjustment_enable (cold increment table 81EE-81F0).
functions.plate_comment: The 100 percent throttle fuelings (e2m 105A, throttle 400 = 100 percent), once per 20 ms as the last call of cm550_runEvery4FramesTaskSetPhase1. While programmable_power_enable is clear it stores three values. throttle_100_fueling (+0 FSMXTHFL) = cm550_calculateBlendedTableValue(engine_rpm_primary, 400). engine_speed_limit_ramped_maximum_fuel_quantity (+4 FSMXBFDP) = the same curve at engine_speed_limit_ramped. throttle_100_fueling_low_horsepower_curve (+2 FST0MXFL) = the steady state 4D fueling table (5DFL01) through cm550_subtractAndClampValue. Each value gets the cold temperature fuel increment (81F0 FLCDICZA over coolant x engine speed) when full_fueling_coolant_temperature_adjustment_enable is set and no coolant fault (status word 2 bits 0x1 / 0x2 / 0x10) is active and latched. Each is then raised to at least fuel_demand_minimum. It always stores throttle_100_fueling_without_programmable_power (+8 FSMTFLNP), raised to at least fuel_demand_minimum: the steady state table value while electronic_smart_power_enable is set, else the blended curve at throttle 400. Counterpart of CM848 cm848_calculateThrottle100Fuelings (0x1f17c), which adds cold_delta_fuel, also writes +6 and forces the interpolation factor to 0 for ESP. CM550 writes +6 (FSMXBK) in selectEngineSpeedLimit (was cm550_FUN_0001cc72).
functions.evidence: CM550 0x1cc72-0x1cdf6 (a2 = 0x80800a fuel_demand_minimum, a3 = 0x80d370, a4 = 0x80ccf6 rpm, a5 = 0x80d36a). andi.l #0x200 of 0x803cb8 bne.w 0x1cd96 skips the curves. Cold d2 = 0 unless 0x803cd4 & 0x8000 is set and none of 0x806004 & 2 / 1 / 0x10 is set together with latch 0x806ac0. In that case d2 = jsr 0x35088(0x800700) with 0x800706 = coolant 0x80a336 and 0x80070e = rpm (0x1cc9e-0x1cd12). jsr 0x1cb76(rpm, 0x190) -> 0x80d368 @0x1cd22. jsr 0x1cb76(0x80d654, 0x190) -> 0x80d36c @0x1cd36, + d2, floored at (a2). 0x8006f0 = rpm, jsr 0x35088(0x8006ea) -> (a5), jsr 0x1e02a(&0x80d36a), then add.w d2 to 0x80d368 and (a5) and floor both (0x1cd52-0x1cd94). andi.l #0x10 of 0x803cac: set -> 0x35088(0x8006ea) -> (a3), 0x1e02a(&0x80d370), floor; else 0x1cb76(rpm, 0x190) -> (a3); final floor (0x1cd96-0x1cdf0). Tables via cm550_FUN_0001cdf8: 0x8006ea = 5DFL01XA / YA / ZA (0x6086e / 0x6089a / 0x608a4) with y input 400; 0x800700 = FLCDTPXA / FLCDESYA / FLCDICZA (0x6124a / 0x6125e / 0x6126a). CM848 0x1f17c: cold_delta_fuel with algorithm_enable_flags_41_cal bit 0x1000; 0x1f03c(speed, 400) -> throttle_100_fueling; 0x164e4(engine_speed_limit_reference) -> sth 0x40a89d (+6); 0x164e4(engine_speed_limit_ramped) -> sth 0x40a89b (+4); 0x566cc steady state grid -> low horsepower curve + 0x1ec48 clamp; for ESP it saves four_dimensional_fueling_interpolation_factor, forces it to 0 around 0x1f03c -> sth 0x40a89f and restores it. Different steps: counterpart. CM550 +6 0x80d36e is written in selectEngineSpeedLimit @0x1d7b6 (0x1cb76(0x80d64e, 400) floored). Only caller jsr @0x1b5c8.

functions.role: At start-up copies the two EEPROM hour meter words into the running key-on and engine hour meters.
functions.discriminator: The only start-up writer of key_on_hour_meter / engine_hour_meter from the EEPROM mirror words 0x803b3e / 0x803b50. Its neighbour advanceHourMeters (0x34512) increments the meters. mc68k_runPowerDownSequence and restartThroughBootRom copy them back into the mirror.
functions.plate_comment: Start-up: loads the running hour meters from their EEPROM copies, called once from mc68k_applicationMain after the input and output channel set-up. key_on_hour_meter = key_on_hour_meter_cal (EEPROM 0x34, mirror 0x803b3e), then engine_hour_meter = engine_hour_meter_cal (EEPROM 0x46, mirror 0x803b50), both in 0.2 s counts. mc68k_runPowerDownSequence and restartThroughBootRom save the two words back. The twin of CM848 0x5067bc (the same two long copies in the same order, placed right after the twin advanceHourMeters in both ROMs): one shared name (was cm550_FUN_0003452a / cm848_loadHourMetersFromEeprom).
functions.evidence: Step by step. CM550 0x3452a: move.l (0x803b3e).l,(0x80bda4).l; move.l (0x803b50).l,(0x80ccee).l; rts @0x3453e. CM848 0x5067bc: lwz r11 0x3fd4b2 (key_on_hour_meter_cal) / stw 0x40a64c (key_on_hour_meter); lwz r9 0x3fd4c4 (engine_hour_meter_cal) / stw 0x40a794 (engine_hour_meter); blr. Step 1 is the key-on meter, step 2 the engine meter, with nothing else and no constants. Position: each body directly follows the shared twin advanceHourMeters (CM550 0x34512 / CM848 0x506780). Each has one caller, the application start-up: CM550 jsr @0x2870e in mc68k_applicationMain after mc68k_initializeDiscreteOutputDrivers; CM848 cm848_applicationMain after cm848_initializeAmbientAirTemperatureChannel. The EEPROM offsets keep the same 0x12 spacing (CM550 0x34 / 0x46, CM848 0x30 / 0x42). EEPROM dump: offset 0x34 = 227512040 = RAM 0x803b3e, offset 0x46 = 226203089 = RAM 0x803b50 = engine_hour_meter (the engine was stopped). Live key_on_hour_meter 227515497 has run on since the last save. Neither firmware has another row named loadHourMetersFromEeprom; CM848 0x5067bc has no function_definitions row.

Cleared while the engine is stopped.

globals.comment: e2m 11EA +6 WPO2DY 'CALCULATED TIME BASED ON COOLANT_TEMPERATURE TO ALLOW OIL TO RE(ACH THE TURBO)' (SEC 0.05). The coolant temperature lookup (11EF WPCQXA -> 11EE WPDYTMYA, descriptor 0x80058e), taken once oil pressure has stayed above the threshold for the calibrated time. The delay timer counts up to it.

Adds 1 per running pass while one of seven fault bits is active and latched: status word 3 0x4 / 0x8 / 0x20 / 0x40, word 2 0x2 / 0x1, word 6 0x2000 (the 'active coolant or oil pressure fault' of 11EB +6 WPFUTMCN). globals.comment: e2m 11EA +C WPRYTM 'TIMER COUNTING AGAINST OIL_BLEEDDOWN_TIME' (MIN, 0.000833 min = one 50 ms pass). Adds 1 per pass while engine_state is STOPPED, up to engine_warmup_protection_oil_drain_back_time (11EB +8 WPRYTMCN, 3600 = 3 min here). Reaching it arms the protection for the next start. Cleared while cranking or running. Dump 3600 (armed).

globals.comment: e2m 11EA +E WPSTFG 'RUN_STATE HAS BEEN ACHIEVED DURING EXECUTION OF ENGINE WARMUP ALGO(RITHM)'. Cleared when the drain-back time arms the protection. While the engine is stopped a nonzero value ends the protection (completed 1, limiting 0, WPACFT 0). The dumped ROM has no writer of 1.

Set when the oil pressure timer passes 11EB +2 WPO2TMCN, at the same time as the delay time is looked up. While it is set the delay timer counts in place of the oil pressure timer. Cleared while stopped.
globals.evidence: 11EA +10 -> 0x80ccc2. clr.w @0x16eac; tst.w @0x16fe4; move.w #1 @0x17016.

globals.comment: e2m 11EA +12 WPO2TDTM 'TIMER COUNTING AGAINST OIL_PRESSURE_THRESHOLD_TIME' (SEC 0.05). Adds 1 per running pass while oil_pressure_sensor_state.filtered_value is at or above engine_warmup_protection_oil_pressure_threshold, else resets to 0. Above engine_warmup_protection_oil_pressure_time it starts the rifle to turbocharger delay. Cleared while stopped.

globals.comment: e2m 11EA +18 WPACFT 'WARMUP PROTECTION LIMITING TORQUE/RPM IF 1'. Set together with the limiting flag when the drain-back time arms the protection, and cleared wherever the protection ends. Unlike engine_warmup_protection_fuel_limiting_flag it is not set at start-up. The dumped ROM has no reader. Dump 1.

roles.role: Converts the torque derate torque limit (e2m 1051 +A TQDQTQ, lb-ft) into a fuel limit. It first raises the maximum torque at current rpm (0x80db1a, e2m 1461 +0 MTMPRPFL) to 1 when it is below 1. Then it computes fuel = no_load_fuel_quantity + cm550_scaleByRatioSigned(torque_derate_torque_limit, 105A +8 FSMTFLNP 0x80d370 - no_load_fuel_quantity, max torque), a 64-bit signed scale, and floors the result at 0. When the result is below torque_derate_fuel_quantity, it becomes the new limit and torque_derate_fuel_source_code = torque_derate_torque_limit_state. Last, it resets torque_derate_torque_limit = 0xFFFF and its state = 40 FUELING_STATE_NO_DERATE (asm 0x1c140 / 0x1c148). Its only caller is the bsr.w at 0x1c190 in cm550_selectFinalFueling, right after jsr cm550_runFuelLimitChains, and only while torque_derate_override_enable is clear.
roles.discriminator: It is the only step that turns the torque limit into fuel, through the maximum torque at current rpm and the 100 percent fueling without programmable power. applyPowerTakeOffTorqueLimit only lowers the torque limit. The apply*FuelLimit steps fold fuel limits that are already fuel. This body also uses the torque limit up and clears it, and 0x1c308 sets that clear state at start-up.

CM848 stores 0xffff / FUELING_STATE_NO_DERATE in the caller cm848_arbitrateRequestedFueling BEFORE cm848_processProtectionLimits, so CM848 has no start-up clear and the CM550 body has two more stores. The CM848 name has a bare 'Protection' and 'RateLimited' is wrong. cm848_convertTorqueDerateTorqueLimitToFuelLimit fits (this overlaps batch L4).

roles.role: Runs the engine warmup protection (e2m group EWP 'ENGINE WARMUP PROTECTION GROUP': working block 11EA, calibrations 11EB, tables 11EC-11EF) every 50 ms (cm550_runEvery10FramesTaskSetPhase0; the e2m timers count 0.05 s). Off path: when the enable bit is clear (algorithm_enable_flags_18_cal bit 1, WPEAFG), or the protection has completed and engine_state is not STOPPED, or WPIHFG 0x80ccc8 (inhibited) is set, it sets completed WPSSFG=1, limiting WPLMFG=0, LSLOFG 0x80a8f4=0, WPACFT 0x80ccca=0 and limit WPTQLM = fuel_demand_maximum. STOPPED: it clears the oil pressure, delay, overall and fault timers and counts the oil drain-back timer WPRYTM 0x80ccbe up to WPRYTMCN 0x807ddc (3600 = 3 min in the dump). At that value it ARMS the protection: completed=0, limiting=1, WPSTFG=0, WPACFT=1, and the LSG lock 0x80a8f4=1 when LSLOCN 0x807dde is set. A set WPSTFG ends the protection. It clears WPDYFG and sets the limit to maximum. CRANKING / RUNNING / JUMP_START / REENTRY (2/3/6/7): it clears the drain-back timer and counts the overall timer WPTMMX up to WPMXTMCN (60 s). It counts the fault timer WPFUTM up to WPFUTMCN (6 s) while any of 7 fault pairs is active (status bit and latch bit; status word 3 bits 0x4/0x8/0x20/0x40, word 2 bits 0x2/0x1, word 6 bit 0x2000; the e2m calls them active coolant or oil pressure faults). Either timer at its maximum ends the protection. Before the delay starts, the oil pressure timer WPO2TDTM counts while filtered oil pressure is at or above WPO2TDCN (8 psig) and resets to 0 below it. When it exceeds WPO2TMCN (0.5 s), WPDYFG=1 and WPO2DY = lookupTableInterpolation(record 0x80058e, coolant temperature), the oil-rifle-to-turbocharger delay time. After the delay starts, WPDYTM counts up to WPO2DY and then ends the protection. While limiting, the limit = lookupTableInterpolation(record 0x80059c, engine_rpm_primary), else fuel_demand_maximum. Engine states 4/5/8 change nothing. The return value is d0 left over from the last operation and no caller uses it. In the RAM dump (engine stopped) the protection is armed: WPRYTM = WPRYTMCN = 3600, WPLMFG 1, WPACFT 1, LSLOFG 1, limit 5888.
roles.discriminator: This is the per-pass body. It is the only code that runs the 11EA timers and flags and computes engine_warmup_protection_fuel_limit from the engine speed table. 0x1709e only initializes, and 0x17120 only folds the limit into the chain with state 33. It has no high-rpm logic and no numbered state word, so the current name and the HIGH_RPM_PROTECTION_STATE enum do not apply.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none. No CHR (CM848) e2m has a WP* / 11EA-11EF record; they exist only in the CM550-family e2m files. cm848_updateEngineStartWarmupProtection 0x5055a0 is a different feature, the EMO 'Engine Starting and Warmup Protection AECD' emission level cap (blocks 19B2 / 19B3), with no oil pressure timers and no fuel table.

roles.role: Start-up initializer of the engine warmup protection (asm 0x1709e-0x1711e). It clears WPIHFG 0x80ccc8 (inhibited). When algorithm_enable_flags_18_cal bit 1 (engine_warmup_protection_enable) is set, it ARMS the protection: WPLMFG 0x80ccb2 = 1, WPSSFG 0x80ccb4 = 0, and the LSG lock flag LSLOFG 0x80a8f4 = 1 when LSLOCN 0x807dde is set. Otherwise WPLMFG = 0 and WPSSFG = 1. It then builds the two lookupTableInterpolation records: 0x80058e {index 2, x 0x60846 WPCQXA coolant temperature axis, y 0x6085a WPDYTMYA rifle-to-turbo delay time} and 0x80059c {index 2, x 0x607f2 WPESXA engine speed axis, y 0x6081c WPFLDQYA fuel derate values}. The axis addresses are the parameter ID table entries of blocks 11EF / 11EE / 11ED / 11EC. It is called once from mc68k_applicationMain (jsr at 0x28812). The return value is d0 left over from the last operation and no caller uses it.
roles.discriminator: It runs once at start-up. It arms the protection at every power-up (the time the engine was off is unknown) and sets up the two table records that 0x16dd4 uses. No fuel temperature is involved anywhere, so 'fuelTemperatureLimitingSecondary' has no support.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none (CM848 has no engine warmup protection; see 0x16dd4).

verdicts.final_comment: The engine warmup protection state machine (e2m 11EA / 11EB, enable WPEAFG = algorithm_enable_flags_18_cal bit 1), one pass per 50 ms from cm550_runEvery10FramesTaskSetPhase0. Off path: with the feature disabled, with engine_warmup_protection_inhibit_flag (WPIHFG) set, or once the protection has completed while engine_state is not STOPPED, it ends the protection (completed 1, limiting 0, low_speed_governor_lock_flag 0, WPACFT 0) and sets engine_warmup_protection_fuel_limit (WPTQLM) to fuel_demand_maximum. With the engine STOPPED it clears the oil pressure, delay, overall and fault timers and the delay started flag and counts engine_warmup_protection_oil_drain_back_timer up to engine_warmup_protection_oil_drain_back_time (3 min here). At that time it arms the protection for the next start: engine_warmup_protection_fuel_limiting_flag 1, completed 0, WPACFT 1, and low_speed_governor_lock_flag 1 when LSLOCN is set (a set WPSTFG ends it again). While stopped the limit stays at fuel_demand_maximum. While cranking / running / jump start / reentry it ends the protection (completed 1, limiting 0) when the overall timer reaches the maximum time, when the fault timer (counting while one of seven coolant or oil pressure fault bits is active and latched) reaches the maximum time with a fault, or when the rifle to turbocharger delay has run out. That delay is looked up from coolant temperature (WPCQXA / WPDYTMYA) once oil pressure has stayed at or above WPO2TDCN for more than WPO2TMCN. In these states the limit is the engine speed table value (WPESXA / WPFLDQYA) while limiting, else fuel_demand_maximum. Engine brake, overspeed and shutdown change nothing. cm550_applyEngineWarmupProtectionFuelLimit applies the limit (was cm550_highRpmEngineProtectionStateMachine - nothing in it is about high engine speed).
